common.offline: You're offline. Your messages will be sent as soon as you're back online.

tonight.title: What are you up to tonight?
tonight.body: Football on the Corniche, a movie, tea with friends… outings near you, created by people like you.

alone.title: Come along, even if you don't know anyone
alone.body: See who's coming and break the ice in the group before the big day. Everyone here is looking to make friends.

trust.title: Free, or everyone pays their share
trust.body: No payments in the app. Rated organizers, 18+ only, and reporting is always one tap away.

demo.a2: Same, let's meet in front of the lighthouse
demo.title: Football on the Corniche

login.title: Sign in
login.subtitle: No password: pick your account, or get a code by email.

errors.generic: Oops, that didn't work. Try again in a moment.
errors.network: No connection. Check your network and try again.
errors.provider: Signing in with {{provider}} failed. Try again, or use your email.

errors.invalid: Wrong code. Check it and try again.

errors.age_min: Lokky is for people aged 18 and over.
errors.duplicate_interests: The same interest was picked twice.

screen.title: Oops, something got stuck
screen.body: It's not you, it's us. We've been notified. Try again in a moment.

you.title: Let's get to know you
you.body: Just the essentials: your first name shows on your profile, your date of birth stays private.
you.firstNameError: Your first name must be 2 to 30 characters long.

situation.title: About you
situation.body: So we can suggest outings that suit you.

permissions.title: Last step
permissions.body: Two permissions to make the most of Lokky. You can change them anytime.
permissions.locationBody: To see outings near you. Only while you use the app.
permissions.notificationsBody: To know when someone joins your outing or messages you.

errors.save: Couldn't save your profile. Try again.

discover.title: What are you up to tonight?

empty.title: No outings for these filters…
empty.body: Why not create one? Others are waiting for just that.

error.title: Couldn't load outings
error.body: Check your connection and try again.

activity.firstTimers_one: First time? {{count}} person is new to Lokky too.
activity.firstTimers_other: First time? {{count}} people are new to Lokky too.
activity.creator: Organized by
activity.left: You're no longer going to this outing.

errors.activity_full: Too late, the outing is full.
errors.generic: Oops, that didn't work. Try again.

upcoming.title: Nothing planned yet
upcoming.body: The outings you join will show up here.

past.title: No memories yet
past.body: Your past outings will show up here.

created.title: You haven't organized anything yet
created.body: Start your first outing: others are waiting for just that.

messages.title: Messages
messages.emptyBody: Join an outing: its group chat will show up here.

create.title: Create an outing
create.discardBody: What you've filled in will be lost.

errors.generic: Couldn't publish right now. Try again.
errors.startsAt: This time has passed: pick another one.

what.title: What?
what.body: Pick a category and give it a name that makes people want to come.
what.titleError: The title must be 3 to 60 characters long.
what.descriptionPlaceholder: What you'll do, what to bring…

when.title: When?
when.body: A concrete date makes it easier to say yes.
when.noSlots: No more slots today: pick another day.

where.title: Where?
where.body: The place and the meeting point, so nobody gets lost.
where.meetingPointPlaceholder: In front of the main entrance, at the lighthouse…

count.title: How many?
count.body: Including you. A small group makes it easier to come alone.

cost.title: How much does it cost?
cost.body: No payments in the app: you sort it out in the group chat.
cost.freeBody: Nothing to pay, just show up.
cost.splitBody: Tickets, transport, drinks… everyone covers themselves.

review.title: Summary
review.body: Here's your outing as it will appear in Discover.

profile.title: Profile
profile.notFound: This profile is no longer available.
profile.blockedNotice: You blocked {{name}}. You no longer see each other's outings and can't message each other.
profile.blockBody: You won't see each other's outings or be able to message each other. {{name}} won't be notified.
profile.dmLockedBody: On Lokky, you can message someone privately after sharing an outing. Join an outing with {{name}}, and you'll be able to chat afterwards.
profile.error: Oops, that didn't work. Try again.

suspended.title: Your account is suspended
suspended.body: Following reports, you can't join or create outings for now. Lokky's rules protect everyone: please follow them when you're back.

banned.title: Your account has been closed
banned.body: Following repeated breaches of Lokky's rules, your account can no longer be used. If you think this is a mistake, write to us from your account's email address.

chat.firstMessage: Break the ice: say hi to the group!
chat.firstMessageBody: Introduce yourself, ask who's coming alone, or offer to travel together.
chat.readOnly: This conversation is closed: the outing ended more than 7 days ago.
chat.notMember: Join the outing to chat with the group.
chat.readOnlyDirect: You can no longer message this person.

review.title: How was it?
review.body: Rate {{name}}, who organized it. Your review helps others come with confidence.
review.commentPlaceholder: What you liked, what could be better…
review.thanksBody: Your review helps the whole community.
review.error: Couldn't send your review. Try again.

attendance.title: Who came?
attendance.body: Untick those who didn't show up. It counts toward their attendance rate, so be fair.

report.title: Report
report.body: Why do you want to report {{target}}? Your report is anonymous.
report.done: Thank you. The Lokky team will review your report.
report.error: Couldn't send the report. Try again.
report.safety: In immediate danger? Call 17 (police) or 18 (fire department).

settings.title: Settings

editProfile.title: My profile
editProfile.firstNameError: Your first name must be 2 to 30 characters long.

notif.title: Notifications
notif.body: Choose what deserves to buzz your phone.
notif.messagesBody: New messages in your groups and private chats.
notif.activityUpdatesBody: Someone joins your outing, an outing is changed or cancelled.
notif.remindersBody: A reminder before each outing, and the review to leave afterwards.
notif.phoneOffTitle: Notifications are blocked on this phone
notif.phoneOffBody: Until your phone allows them, you won't receive anything, even if everything is on below.

blockedList.title: Blocked people
blockedList.emptyBody: If someone makes you uncomfortable, you can block them from their profile.

delete.title: Delete my account
delete.body: This is permanent. Your profile, your upcoming outings and your messages will be deleted, and you'll leave all your outings.
delete.error: Couldn't delete your account. Try again.

settings.signOutBody: You can sign back in anytime with your email, Apple or Google. Your outings and messages will be waiting for you.

goodbye.title: Your account has been deleted
goodbye.body: Thanks for being part of Lokky. See you around, maybe!
